name: Dolly in
description: Move the camera 1 unit toward the subject along z.

name: Crane up
description: Raise the camera 1 unit along y.

name: Orbit left
description: Circle the subject at radius 5, travelling to the camera's left (angle -90).

name: Pan right
description: Turn the camera 30 degrees to the right (yaw -30).

name: Dolly zoom in
description: Dolly 1 unit toward the subject while narrowing the field of view from 50 to 30.
